---
title: "Contact 360PE"
description: "Contact 360 Political Ecology for editorial enquiries, corrections and research collaborations."
---

360 Political Ecology welcomes evidence-based feedback, editorial enquiries, correction requests, research collaboration proposals, and responsible media enquiries.

## Enquiries

- **Research and interdisciplinary collaboration** — scholarship and shared evidence projects
- **Editorial correspondence** — submissions or proposals connected to the [ten areas of analysis](topics.qmd)
- **Evidence and corrections** — source questions, data issues, substantive corrections
- **Media and educational enquiries** — interviews, explanatory material and learning partnerships

::: {.callout-note}
## Contact email setup pending

A dedicated domain email address will be published **after it has been configured and tested**. We intend to use **contact@360politicalecology.org**, but it is **not yet confirmed as operational**. Please do not send enquiries there until the address is activated.
:::

**Website:** [360politicalecology.org](https://360politicalecology.org)

For publication corrections, please include the article title, page/section, disputed claim and a reliable supporting source when possible.
